_comment: Default AUTO_APPROVAL policy copied into each new project as projects/<ID>/approval_policy.json. Engine-enforced (studio/autonomy.py). Agents cannot edit the project copy (hook-guarded); humans change it with `studio.py policy ...`. GATE-07 (budget/spending) is a hard human gate in code and cannot be set to policy. A gate listed in client_approval_gates always needs a human. External requirements block ANY approval (human or policy) of their gate until a human records documented evidence.
